en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a serene lake with reflections, framed by overhanging branches and a tree in the foreground. Across the water stands a stately building, identifiable as the Grillenburg hunting lodge (Jagtschloß Grillenburg), partially obscured by trees. There appears to be a small stone bridge on the right. The text 'Jagdschoß Grillenburg' is visible in the lower corner.
